tasks.title: Name-only edits preserve exact JSON pointers and Checks editors have the required browser checks and guide
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Tasks 1-5, Completion evidence and Acceptance evidence 1-6; Required behavior 1-7 and Counterexamples; Security impact checklist. Implement the pointer regression test before removing only the pointer read's .trim(); keep its red/green output. Add both browser checks together in checkScreensWith, using the literal create/edit Tab sequences of Task 2, both JavaScript modes and all twelve EDITORS at 1280 x 800. A different Chromium Tab order requires needs-input with the observed sequence, as specified; do not change the expected sequence to match it. Add the module guide and exact-pointer sentence. src/styles.ts is conditional: change it only if the browser checks expose an outline or layout defect permitted by Tasks 2-3, without hiding overflow, and report that fix. Finish the security checklist, manual exercise, whole-repository checks, existing Compose CI check and final PR evidence, including correctly labelled coverage from the final bun run check run.

acceptance.expected: Before changing src/check-form.ts, the new name-only edit test derives posted values from editInputOf of a stored view with [{ pointer: "/status ", equals: "ok" }, { pointer: "/ready ", exists: true }] and fails because the old parser receives "/status" instead of the literal expected "/status ". Record the command and assertion output; a coverage-threshold failure alone is not the required red result.

After removing only .trim() from the assertion pointer read, all tests in this file pass with 0 fail. The stored name-only edit preserves the literal assertion array; create preserves "/a b\t"; " /status" and "   " in exists mode produce the fixed assert_0_pointer message 'Enter a JSON pointer such as /status, or leave it empty for the whole body.'; an empty exists pointer remains { pointer: "", exists: true }; mode none ignores its row; name " Web shop 2 " becomes "Web shop 2" and a URL with surrounding spaces still parses. A focused run may fail the global coverage threshold despite passing these tests; the final full suite owns that gate. Record the green assertion result.

All tests in this file pass with 0 fail, regardless of a focused-run global coverage-threshold failure. The new stored-view regression first verifies rendered assert_0_pointer and assert_1_pointer values of "/status " and "/ready ", then submits those rendered values with only name changed to "Web shop 2". It receives 303, observes exactly GET /admin/config followed by PUT /admin/checks/web, and asserts the PUT name and jsonAssert against the literal stored fixture. A leading-space pointer receives 422 with the existing field message and no PUT.

Exit 0 on the final change: lint, root and e2e typechecks and the full Bun test suite pass with the existing 80% line-coverage gate. Retain the final test counts and the All files row, copying % Funcs as function coverage and % Lines as line coverage exactly as printed for the PR body.

Exit 0. For JavaScript on and JavaScript off, the committed check reaches every stop in Task 2's independent literal HTTP create/edit sequences by successive Tab presses, verifies outlineStyle === 'solid' and outlineWidth === '2px', and leaves form.check-editor one Tab after Submit. The check measures all 12 EDITORS at 1280 x 800 with assertFits(page, 1280, ...) and form bounds left >= 0 and right <= 1280. The ok output names the editor Tab check and '12 editors fit 1280 px' in both modes; existing quorum text, axe, design-matrix and 390 px list/detail checks still pass.

With a fake API serving a stored trailing-space assertion, manually open the edit form, change only the name and save. Inspect the outbound PUT and confirm it keeps the literal "/status ". Record this command, fixture setup and observed result in the PR body; merely starting the service is insufficient.

Security checklist review confirms exact-pointer validation rejects leading-space and spaces-only values with the fixed message and no write; rejected values are retained only through the existing escapeHtml input helper and are absent from logs, headers and error-message text. The 422 and reusable form-token behavior, API contract validation and auth/check order stay unchanged. Record the applicable input-validation and external-data error/log checklist results in the PR evidence.

AGENTS.md under This repository contains Task 4's complete guide with verified route/page/parser/read/write/outcome/helper/test module paths, editInputOf, exact pointer semantics, If-Match writes, role/form-token gates and write-only Keep/Replace/Remove handling. docs/checks.md under Editor fields states that pointers are used exactly as entered and a space is part of a key name and is never removed.

acceptance.command: git diff main -- package.json bun.lock src/permissions.ts src/form-tokens.ts src/server.ts
acceptance.expected: Empty diff: the contract pin, roles, form tokens and dispatcher order remain unchanged.

Only src/check-form.ts, src/check-form.test.ts, src/server.checks-change.test.ts, e2e/run.ts, AGENTS.md and docs/checks.md change; src/styles.ts may additionally change only for an outline or layout defect exposed by the new checks and described in the PR. No routes, dependencies, tooling or CI change.

The final PR's existing CI checks pass, including deploy-dev: its current workflow builds the dev Compose stack with this checkout and runs E2E_CONSOLE_FLOW=two-factor bash e2e/console-setup.sh dev/compose.yaml from pulse-deploy after readiness. Follow Console AGENTS.md if that flow exposes a deploy defect; do not edit deploy or weaken the job.

The PR body names Closes lorenzh/pulse-meta#<child> with the actual child issue number, the checks and known limits; includes the old-code assertion failure and new-code passing result with commands/output, final bun run check counts and All files % Funcs labelled function coverage and % Lines labelled line coverage copied as printed, both browser modes' new ok lines, the manual command/result, applicable security checklist evidence and any permitted src/styles.ts fix.
